newsitem.title: USA: ConEd says N.Y. nuke may restart in a week.
newsitem.headline: ConEd says N.Y. nuke may restart in a week.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York (ConEd) said Wednesday its 975 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 2 nuclear power unit, shut Sunday for repairs, may restart in approximately one week but further testing is required.
"We are still in the midst of inspections. A more precise date will be forthcoming when on-going inspections are complete," company spokeswoman Joan Burger said.
"We want to find the root cause of the malfunction," she said, adding repairs will be made when the cause is found.
The unit, at the Indian Point facility along the Hudson River in upstate New York, was shut Sunday when problems were detected with a feedwater valve.
The adjacent 965 MW unit 3, operated by New York Power Authority, has been shut since January 18 and will likely be down until mid-February.
